about.title: Code, not
about.intro: I design and ship premium showcase websites and custom SaaS for studios, independents, and small teams who care how their work looks online. A site that is fast, secure, genuinely yours — and that won't turn into technical debt two years from now.

craft.label: Built by an engineer
craft.body: Every line handwritten on a dedicated stack, Next.js + Tailwind. No theme, no generator, no technical debt.

openSource.label: Open-source, fully yours
openSource.body: Everything I build is auditable, exportable and yours to keep. No proprietary lock-in: you stay free to walk away with your code.

fairPrice.label: Fair price, premium quality
fairPrice.body: No agency overhead: you pay for the work, not the structure. And quality is measurable — Lighthouse ≥ 90 guaranteed.

hosting.label: Sovereign hosting, in Europe
hosting.body: Your site lives on a private European server, in an isolated, encrypted space. Native GDPR, automated backups, Cloudflare included.

followUp.label: Follow-up like nowhere else
followUp.body: After delivery you keep direct access to my advice, my feedback and my technical calls. Answered within 72 business hours.

workspace.label: Your dedicated client space
workspace.body: A private space to follow the project live: whiteboard, forum, shared documents, structured feedback. Nothing lost in email threads.

portfolio.title: What I've
portfolio.subtitle: Real projects, online — each thought through and built end to end.
